dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: Him? Well, to be honest, his duties cover all sorts of things. You can just think of him as the "General Manager" in charge of us workers.

dialogues.speaker: Nekrasov
dialogues.text: After all, everything from paying wages to fixing equipment has to go through him. That means he's always short-handed, and he often needs people to help out with odd jobs.
